    input  logic       rst_n,
    input  logic [1:0] mode,
    input  logic       din,
    output logic [3:0] dout
);

    logic [3:0] shift_reg;

    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        case (1'b1)
            rst_n == 1'b0: shift_reg <= 4'b0000;
            default: begin
                case (mode)
                    2'b00:   shift_reg <= shift_reg;           // hold
                    2'b01:   shift_reg <= {shift_reg[2:0], din}; // shift left
                    2'b10:   shift_reg <= {din, shift_reg[3:1]}; // shift right
                    2'b11:   shift_reg <= {shift_reg[2:0], shift_reg[3]}; // rotate
                endcase
            end
        endcase
    end
